Please crop the design part cleanly, remove any background or extra elements, and enhance the image to make it high-resolution and print-ready for fabric printing. Maintain the original design’s clarity, colors, and proportions. The output should be a transparent PNG with no background. (Tested)

DTF Design.title: T-Shirt Design Recreation – High-Resolution Print-Ready Artwork (300 DPI PNG)
DTF Design.description: I have a T-shirt design that I need to have recreated in high-resolution for printing. Please find the attached image of the current design. Your task is to: Recreate the Design: Create a new, similar design that is faithful to the original concept, layout, and elements. Enhance to Full HD Quality: The final design must be in high resolution, suitable for high-quality T-shirt printing. Please provide it at a minimum of 300 DPI and with dimensions of at least 4500x5400 pixels. Improve Color Quality: Enhance the colors of the original design to make them more vibrant, crisp, and visually appealing for print. Ensure the color profile is suitable for direct-to-garment (DTG) or screen printing. Provide a Printable .PNG File: The final output must be a high-resolution .PNG file with a transparent background. This is crucial so the design can be printed on any color T-shirt without a background box.

Output only the updated bottom wear design on a plain white or transparent background, without any clothes or models. Ensure the image is high-quality, high-resolution (print-ready, high DPI), and ready for textile printing use.

Studio Background.title: Background Generation Without Apparel

Keep the environment, background texture, and setup consistent with the reference image, allowing slight creative variation for uniqueness. - If there are any clothes or apparel — including top wear (like t-shirts, shirts, jackets) or bottom wear (like leggings, joggers, pants, shorts, skirts, or bottoms of any type) — remove them completely. If there is a hanger, rack, or stand used to hang clothes, keep it exactly as it is. Outfit Creation.title: Outfit Design & Color Coordination With Design for E-Commerce Collection
Outfit Creation.description:
Act as a professional kidswear designer for a major fashion brand. I am providing you with a graphic design for a T-shirt and a color palette for a collection of full-sleeve T-shirts and Joggers.

Your task is to create the perfect, on-trend, and commercially appealing outfit combination for kids. This involves selecting the best top and bottom colors from my collection to pair with the design, and you have the creative freedom to suggest color adjustments to the design itself to achieve a cohesive, 'big brand' look.

To complete this task, you must:

- Analyze the Design: Thoroughly examine the provided graphic design. Identify its key colors, style (e.g., playful, modern, retro), and overall mood.
Select the Optimal Top and Bottom: From the provided color collections, choose the single best color for the full-sleeve T-shirt and the single best color for the leghi that:
- Perfectly complements the graphic design.
Creates a stylish and harmonious overall look.

Is appropriate and appealing for kids' fashion, keeping in mind that children are often drawn to bright and happy colors.[1][2][3]

- Design Color Synchronization (If Necessary): If the original design colors don't perfectly match your chosen top and bottom, you are encouraged to propose specific color modifications to the graphic design. Present these changes clearly, explaining how they create better synergy with the apparel colors. The goal is a seamless and intentional color story across all three elements (design, top, and bottom).
Provide a Design Rationale: Justify your choices like a true professional. Your explanation should cover:
- Color Theory: Briefly explain why your chosen color combination works (e.g., complementary, analogous, triadic).
- Trend Awareness: Reference current or upcoming kids' fashion color trends (e.g., pastels, earthy tones, vibrant hues).[4][5][6][7][8]
- Child Psychology: Touch upon why this color palette is suitable for children, considering the psychological impact of colors (e.g., calming blues, energetic yellows).[1][9][10][11][12]
- Brand Appeal: Explain how the final combination achieves a high-end, cohesive look reminiscent of a leading kids' clothing brand.

Final Output Requirements:
Clear Recommendations: State your final chosen color for the T-shirt and the Joggers. 
Design Modification Mock-up (if applicable): If you suggest changes to the design's colors, provide a clear description or a simple visual representation of the updated design.
Detailed Rationale: Present your comprehensive design rationale as outlined above.
Generated output: Should use the reference image, similar framing and studio style of photoshoot be final output. 

Input: color_code.png and design image

Outfit Creation.title: Top-5 Multi-Colorway Outfit Creation with Design Harmony
Outfit Creation.description:
Role: You are an AI Fashion Designer with a specialization in color theory and trend forecasting for the kidswear market.
Objective: To generate a series of updated color options for a given kidswear catalog image, using a predefined set of color codes for the top and bottom garments.


Task Description:
Ingest and Analyze: Process both the catalog image and the color code file.
Strategic Color Pairing: From the provided color collections, generate the five most aesthetically pleasing and commercially viable color pairings for the top and bottom. Your selections should aim for a variety of styles (e.g., bold & contrasting, monochromatic, complementary, pastel).
Intelligent Color Application: For each of the five selected pairings, create a new version of the catalog image.
The color of the 'top' garment in the image should be replaced with the selected top color code.
The color of the 'bottom' garment in the image should be replaced with the selected bottom color code.
The 'design' element must be preserved. If the new background color of the top or bottom clashes with the design, intelligently adjust the colors within the design to ensure it remains visible and harmonious.

Inputs:
- Kidswear Catalog Image: An image containing a three-part outfit: a top, a bottom, and an integrated design/graphic.
- Color Code File: A structured file (e.g., JSON, CSV) containing two distinct lists of color codes (e.g., HEX, RGB): one for the 'Top Collection' and one for the 'Bottom Collection'.


Output: 
- Provide the five newly generated images, each clearly labeled with the color codes used for the top and bottom.

Outfit Creation.title: Top-5 Multi-Colorway Outfit Creation with Design Harmony + Reasoning
Outfit Creation.description:
Act as an expert fashion designer specializing in children's apparel. I am providing you with two files:

- [Catalog Image File Name]: An image from our kidswear catalog showing an outfit with a top, a bottom, and a graphic design.
- [Color Code File Name]: A file containing our seasonal color palettes, with specific color codes for a 'Tops Collection' and a 'Bottoms Collection'.

Your creative task is to generate new, exciting, and commercially viable colorways for this outfit. You should:
Analyze the Color Palettes: Review the provided color codes for both the top and bottom collections.
Propose Color Combinations: Based on your design expertise, create at least three new and distinct color combinations for the top and bottom. Consider principles of color theory, current trends in kidswear, and creating a harmonious look with the existing design element. For each combination, briefly explain your reasoning (e.g., 'This combination is playful and vibrant,' 'This offers a more classic, gender-neutral look').

Maintain the original lighting and shadows of the outfit image. The final result should look like a professional kidswear catalog photo with the design seamlessly integrated.

Apply the design only on one side of the bottom wear (left or right leg area), keeping it small, neat, and well-balanced, suitable for printing or embroidery. After applying the new design, ensure the entire outfit (top and bottom) looks like a single, cohesive set — visually connected in style, tone, and color harmony. Maintain a realistic, high-quality, and photography-ready look, preserving natural fabric texture, lighting, and shadows so the final result appears as an authentic catalog image.

Catalog [Without Model].title: Transform Catalog Image into Flat Lay Kidswear Setup (Top-Down Studio Composition)
Catalog [Without Model].description:
Transform the given catalog image (either hanging or model-worn) into a flat lay setup . 

Camera angle:
Capture from a true top-down (90° overhead) position — camera lens perfectly parallel to the flat surface.

Layout composition:

	Top piece (shirt/top):
	Place it centered horizontally and about 60% up from the bottom edge of your frame.
	Align the neckline straight, facing up.
	Keep sleeves in relaxed look.

	Bottom piece (shorts/pants/skirt):
	Position directly below the top, with a 2–3 cm overlap between the bottom hem of the top and the waistband of the bottom.
	The shorts should appear about 15–20° angled outward at both sides for a natural shape.

	Accessories (shoes, props, etc.):
	Place matching shoes on the right side, slightly above the bottom garment — roughly 10–15° outward rotation each shoe.
	If you have props (like flowers, toys, or accessories), position one on the left side beside the top — diagonally at 45° to balance the layout.

	Lighting:
	Use soft natural light from one side (preferably the top-left).
	Avoid harsh shadows; diffuse with a white sheet if needed.

	Background:
	Use a clean white or neutral surface for a minimalist look.

	Framing:
	Leave equal negative space (about 5–8 cm) on all sides of the outfit in your shot.

DTF Style Generator.title: KIDSWEAR DESIGN PROMPT BUILDER TEMPLATE
DTF Style Generator.description:
You can use this to easily generate *new print-ready kidswear designs* in your preferred style, theme, and concept.

---

## 👕 **KIDSWEAR DESIGN PROMPT BUILDER**

### 🧩 Step 1: Choose a Style

(copy exactly one line below)

* `chibi / kawaii style`
* `cartoon / western style`
* `minimal flat vector style`
* `animal mascot style`
* `hand-drawn doodle style`
* `3D cute illustration style`
* `pop art / comic style`
* `Ghibli-inspired painterly style` 🌸

---

### 🌈 Step 2: Choose a Theme

(copy one or mix a few)

* `animal friends` (bunny, bear, panda, puppy)
* `adventure & travel` (bike, plane, balloon, car)
* `dream & fantasy` (unicorn, moon, fairy, rainbow)
* `sports & playtime` (football, skate, dance)
* `seasons & nature` (rain, beach, snow, flowers)
* `love & family` (hugging, heart, together)
* `food & fun` (ice cream, donut, candy)
* `learning & growth` (ABC, books, numbers)
* `festive & celebration` (birthday, Christmas, Diwali)

---

### 👧 Step 3: Choose Character / Scene Type

* Single kid character (boy/girl)
* Siblings or friends playing
* Cute animal behaving like a child
* Fantasy child (fairy, astronaut, mermaid, superhero)
* Hybrid character (child with animal hoodie, ears, or wings)

---

### 🪄 Step 4: Combine into Prompt Format

**Prompt Template:**

> “Create a **[STYLE]** **kidswear print design** showing **[CHARACTER/SCENE]** in a **[THEME]** setting. Use **soft pastel colors**, **clean outlines**, and **print-ready composition** suitable for fabric. Keep the background **transparent** (PNG). The artwork should look cheerful, child-friendly, and high-quality for clothing printing.”

---

### 🧸 **Example 1 (Kawaii Style)**

> “Create a chibi / kawaii style kidswear print design showing a cute little boy hugging a teddy bear under stars (animal friends theme). Use flat pastel colors, thick outlines, transparent background, print-ready, high resolution.”

### 🌿 **Example 2 (Ghibli-Inspired Style)**

> “Create a Ghibli-inspired painterly kidswear print design of a child feeding a bunny in a grassy field (nature theme). Use soft watercolor shading, simplified background, gentle colors, transparent PNG, print-ready.”

### 🏀 **Example 3 (Minimal Vector)**

> “Create a minimal flat vector style kidswear print design showing two siblings playing football (sports theme). Simple shapes, pastel colors, clean layout, transparent background.”
